hints.title: Divisibility Observation
hints.text: Notice that within at most ten consecutive increments from n, you will encounter a number ending in zero whose digit product is zero, which is divisible by any t.

hints.title: Sequential Testing
hints.text: Start a loop from n upwards. Compute the product of digits for the current candidate.

hints.title: Termination Check
hints.text: If the digit product modulo t equals zero, return that candidate immediately.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Within at most 10 increments, a multiple of 10 is reached whose digit product is 0.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulation is already optimal and terminates in constant steps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that the digit product of any number ending with 0 is zero, bounding steps to at most 10.
